001: I saw a beautiful dress in the store window, but I wanted to know if it comes in another color.
I think it comes in blue and also in green. Do you want me to ask the saleswoman?
If it's not too much trouble, yes. I prefer the green one, it suits me better.
Sure, no problem. I'll call the attendant so you can try it on.
Thank you! And do you know if the fabric shrinks after washing?
Good question. We'd better confirm that before deciding.
002: Are those sneakers you bought comfortable? I'm thinking about getting the same pair.
They're very comfortable, but the size seems small. I had to exchange them for a bigger pair.
Really? Then maybe I should try them on before buying.
Definitely, and it's also worth checking if there's a discount for paying in cash.
Good idea. Do you remember how much you paid in total?
I paid two hundred and fifty reais, but I think you can negotiate a little.
003: I bought a purse yesterday, but I noticed it came with a defect in the zipper.
That's a shame! Do you have the receipt to try to exchange it?
I do, I kept everything. Do you think they'll accept the exchange without a problem?
They usually accept it if the defect is from the factory and within the deadline.
I hope so. I'll go back there tomorrow to get it sorted out.
Good luck! If you need company, just call me.
004: Did you see the price of that new cell phone? It's very expensive.
I saw it, but it's on sale on the website. It's almost a hundred reais cheaper.
It's worth it then. But I'm afraid of buying online.
I understand, but the website is reliable and it has a seven-day warranty.
That's good. Do you know if shipping is free?
I think so for purchases over three hundred reais.
005: I need to return these pants I bought, but I lost the tag.
Hmm, without the tag it might be harder. Do you still have the receipt?
I have the proof of purchase in the store's app. Do you think that works?
It should work, but maybe they'll only offer a store credit.
That's fine, it's still better than keeping pants that are too tight.
Exactly, and you can still pick another style with the same value.
006: I bought a jacket for the winter, but I thought the fabric was a bit thin.
Look, thin fabric isn't always bad. It depends on the lining.
That's true. Do you think it keeps you warm enough?
Hard to say without seeing it. Can you check the composition label?
Good idea. If it's cotton with a lining, it should be good.
Right, and if it doesn't work out, you can still exchange it at the store.
007: I want to buy a gift for my mom, but I don't know what to choose.
How about a perfume? It's a classic option and she can exchange it if she doesn't like it.
That's a good one, but I'm afraid of getting the scent wrong.
You can ask for a free sample at the store before deciding.
True, many stores offer that. I'll try it.
And remember to keep the receipt to make a possible exchange easier.
008: This television has a great price, but does the warranty cover everything?
It usually covers factory defects, but not damage from misuse.
I see. And is the warranty period one year?
That's right, but you can extend it if you pay an extra fee.
I don't think I need it, one year is already good enough.
Exactly, and if there's a problem, they're required to fix it.
009: I bought some sunglasses, but I thought the price was a bit high.
It depends on the brand and the protection. Good sunglasses tend to be expensive anyway.
Yeah, but the seller guaranteed me they have protection against ultraviolet rays.
Then it was worth it. Just check that it came with the certificate.
It did, everything is in order in the box.
Perfect, then you got a good deal.
010: I'm thinking about buying a new table, but the price is above my budget.
Have you tried negotiating with the seller? A lot of times they give a discount.
Not yet, but I can try. Do you think they'll accept installments?
Probably yes, and without interest if it's up to six payments.
That would help a lot. I'll go back there to talk.
Good luck! If you get a good discount, let me know.
